title: ToolReceipt
description: Actual tool, arguments digest, result/effect digest, start/end time and executor identity (plan: 'Wire contracts'). Relates to a2a_compliance.lifecycle.ControlReceipt: dispatch_id is that dataclass's field, reused verbatim to bind one-or-more ToolReceipts to the ControlReceipt that dispatched them; effect_digest is the per-call analogue of ControlReceipt.observed_effects_digest (which aggregates across a dispatch).

tool.description: the actual tool invoked, not the requested/nominal one

prev_digest.description: OPTIONAL: the subject_digest (NOT the signature, NOT a whole-envelope hash) of the immediately preceding receipt in this chain; absent only on a chain's first (genesis) receipt. See wire/chain.py:verify_chain.
